Digestion Acid(s).cell: 0.2 mL HF + 0.1 mL HNO3 + 0.4 mL water; then 0.2 mL HNO3 + 0.2 mL HCl + 0.2 mL H2O2; final 0.2 mL HNO3 + 0.2 mL H2O2

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: PFA hexagonal cap vials (6 mL, Savillex), tightly capped with polypropylene wrenches to maintain high-pressure conditions
Digestion Vessel Type.value: PFA hexagonal cap vials (6 mL, Savillex), tightly capped with polypropylene wrenches to maintain high-pressure conditions

Digestion Step.cell: 1: 0.2 mL HF + 0.1 mL HNO3 + 0.4 mL water | 2: 0.2 mL HNO3 + 0.2 mL HCl + 0.2 mL H2O2 | 3: 0.2 mL HNO3 + 0.2 mL H2O2. The paper describes four heating stages; on the recorded acid mixtures these span three distinct attacks, the remaining stages being evaporation and uptake within a step.

Digestion Temperature.cell: 120 C, then 220 C, then 100 C; second stage 150 C; final 80 C

Digestion Duration.cell: 3 h ultrasonic agitation, 12 h at 120 C, 5 days at 220 C, 1 day at 150 C, 1 day at 80 C

Final Solution Matrix.cell: 5 mL 0.5 M HNO3, dilution factors 1200 (A0066) to 3400 (A0259); Group-1 aliquots diluted to DF 20,000; Group-3 in 0.5 M HNO3 + ~0.05 M HF

Reaction Product Ion / Mass-Shift Transi.cell: N/A — on-mass measurement in KED mode

Internal Standard Element.cell: 103Rh for the calibration-curve elements; 113In-203Tl for the ID-IS method; 91Zr and 179Hf for Nb and Ta

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: Three strategies by group: calibration curve with 103Rh internal standardisation; 113In-203Tl ID-IS (Yokoyama et al. 2017); isotope dilution for Ti, Zr, Mo, Hf and W; 91Zr and 179Hf as internal standards for Nb and Ta

Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.cell: ID-IS method of Kagami and Yokoyama (2021); isotope dilution for Ti, Zr, Mo, Hf and W
